PROP-6a4369e9-pre-007.text: Gossip validation must reject sidecar on wrong subnet (index % SUBNET_COUNT != subnet_id).
PROP-6a4369e9-pre-007.assertion: forall sidecar: accepted_on(sidecar, subnet) => sidecar.index % DATA_COLUMN_SIDECAR_SUBNET_COUNT == subnet

locations.note: Validates sidecar is published on correct subnet based on index % DATA_COLUMN_SIDECAR_SUBNET_COUNT
